mestre_geometric_discriminant_v2.json.proof: The quotient geometric MW lattice has rank6 and determinant1/4; its Galois-fixed rank5 lattice has determinant1/2. An involution with rank-one anti space has eigenspace index1 or2. The quotient height lower bound1 forces anti height2 and index2. This generator is narrow. Its degree-two pullback has height4 and integral primitive anti NS class of square-4. The quotient index2 glue survives pullback, and the K3 anti space is still rank one, forcing NS eigenspace index2. Thus geometric NS determinant is468*4/4=468. The rational fixed lattice has rank18, so these determinant468 surfaces cannot supply an arithmetic MW17 fibration. Their full Gram and a useful new fibration remain unconstructed.

mestre_parent_picard_and_saturation_v1.j.scope: Frobenius fixes exactly18 rational divisor directions at a certified good prime on each parent. Two incompatible Artin-Tate squareclasses bound geometric Picard rank by19, and the exact5+6 base-involution decomposition supplies the matching lower bound via the rank6 geometric rational quotient. Arithmetic/geometric generic MW ranks are11/12. Complete finite groups show the actual generic basis injects modulo2 and3 at T=1, excluding every possible index in the rank18 arithmetic NS lattice of determinant468. The full geometric NS lattice is not identified. Every Q-fibration on each parent has MW rank at most16; this does not bound specialized elliptic ranks. The twist quotient has an I0* with irreducible cubic at zero, forcing at least two nonrational divisor directions and arithmetic NS rank at most17. No new fibration, rootless-frame search or foundry admission.

height_protocol.gate: Six constructed Q-distinct parents have11 known rational sections and rational reducible fibres. Compute exact Q(T) height Gram and relations of only these supplied sections to identify the known rank18 divisor sublattice before any possible further construction.

point_count_protocol.boundaries: No parameter, point, fibration, rootless-frame, NS saturation or coefficient search. No unbounded prime extension, outcome-dependent replacement or automatic retry. Upper bounds do not assume the Tate conjecture; unresolved ranks remain unknown.
point_count_protocol.gate: Exact rank18 rational divisor sublattices are independently certified. Determine whether Frobenius supplies a matching geometric Picard upper bound before assuming the full NS rank or selecting any further construction.
point_count_protocol.method: Count smooth projective surfaces over Fp and Fp^2. Every smooth fibre character count is independently checked by PARI cardinality. Include two I2 and split I4 resolution corrections. Subtract18 rational divisor eigenvalues and retain every Weil-compatible degree4 orthogonal Frobenius polynomial.
point_count_protocol.prime_policy: First two primes in5..131 satisfying the existing full semistable good-model gate, independently for each of the six already constructed parents.
